verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an inference cloud, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no user-facing control to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The only privacy-related item is a zero-retention policy for inputs and outputs, which is a separate data-retention default rather than a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
